target.title: fix(gateway): trim cron job ids before exact lookup
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`resolveCronJobId` returned `params.id ?? params.jobId` without trimming, while
nearby cron wake paths already trim `sessionKey` / `agentId`. Padded job ids
made `cron.get` / `cron.run` / `cron.remove` / `cron.update` / `cron.runs`
report not found for existing jobs. `cron.update` also bypassed the helper.

## Why This Change Was Made

Trim inside `resolveCronJobId` and route `cron.update` through that helper so
every exact job-id lookup shares one normalization point.

## User Impact

**Before:** `" ${jobId} "` failed as missing/not found.

**After:** Leading/trailing whitespace is stripped before store lookup.

## Evidence

- Changed: `src/gateway/server-methods/cron.ts`,
  `src/gateway/server-methods/cron.validation.test.ts`
- Production path: `cronHandlers` get/run/remove/update/runs →
  `resolveCronJobId` → `context.cron.readJob` / `enqueueRun`
- Compatibility: whitespace-only ids still count as missing

## Real behavior proof

### Behavior or issue addressed

Live Gateway RPC: create a cron job, then `cron.get` with a padded id returns
the job. Whitespace-only id still returns `INVALID_REQUEST` / missing id.

### Canonical reachability path

`openclaw gateway call cron.get` → `resolveCronJobId` (trim) →
`context.cron.readJob(<trimmed>)` → job payload

### Shared helper / provider constraint check

Local helper only; aligns with existing cron wake `.trim()` usage; no new
config.

### Real environment tested

Local trusted source checkout at PR head; isolated `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` /
config / `HOME`; loopback Gateway via `node scripts/run-node.mjs gateway run`;
Node 22.23.1.

### Exact steps or command run after this patch

```bash
# isolated gateway + token on a free loopback port
node scripts/run-node.mjs cron add --name trim-proof --every 1h --session main \
  --system-event "trim proof heartbeat" --url ws://127.0.0.1:$PORT --token $TOKEN --json
node scripts/run-node.mjs gateway call cron.get \
  --params '{"id":" <job-id> "}' --url ws://127.0.0.1:$PORT --token $TOKEN --json
node scripts/run-node.mjs gateway call cron.get \
  --params '{"id":"   "}' --url ws://127.0.0.1:$PORT --token $TOKEN --json
```

### Evidence after fix

Redacted live RPC (padded id succeeds):

```json
{
  "id": "24df4718-c0b2-477a-ac33-2d8e1c348684",
  "name": "trim-proof",
  "enabled": true,
  "schedule": { "kind": "every", "everyMs": 3600000 },
  "sessionTarget": "main",
  "payload": { "kind": "systemEvent", "text": "trim proof heartbeat" }
}
```

Whitespace-only id:

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_REQUEST",
    "message": "invalid cron.get params: missing id"
  }
}
```

### Observed result after fix

A padded existing cron job id resolves through a real Gateway WebSocket
`cron.get` call; whitespace-only input remains invalid.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed and understand the change.
